title: Dexcom G6 Bluetooth Connection Lost for Samsung Galaxy Watch
body:
Lost connection for 4 hours at this point, after the last reading. The app continues to say " G6 state isn't currently known. Next connection will update this" . I restarted the app after two hours and no change.
The Bluetooth Link in the settings shows disconnected and the Deep Sleeping Error count is at 10. 

Firmware version :1.6.5.25
xdrip version: 14fecb8-2019.01.10
          code: 1901102241

comments.body: Did you try with 31st build? I am having issues with the new versions with my Android Wear Ticwatch E.
